title: Software Provisioning and E/E Vehicle Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Join Quantum-Systems and keep our autonomous ground vehicles on the latest software, every day. You flash, update, and bring up our prototypes (Mandrill UGV and autonomous trucks), find out why something does not work, and make sure it works next time without you. You work AI native: you let agentic tools write the scripts that turn manual steps into one command.

Why this role matters? A prototype is only as good as the software running on it. You make sure our engineers test the latest version, on a vehicle that works, with data that explains what happened.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

Provision Software and Firmware

  • Flash new software releases and firmware onto vehicle computers, ECUs, sensors, and radios; verify the result and roll back safely when needed.

  • Keep a clean record of which vehicle runs which software, firmware, and configuration.

  • Turn manual provisioning into repeatable, scripted, documented procedures.

Integrate and Troubleshoot the E/E System

  • Bring up and commission compute, ECUs, sensors, and vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, automotive Ethernet).

  • Find faults systematically across hardware, wiring, network, and software, using multimeter, oscilloscope, and bus tools.

  • Support sensor swaps, harness changes, and upfits on prototype vehicles.

Pull Logs and Find Root Causes

  • Collect logs, traces, and recordings from the vehicle, work through them, and isolate the root cause.

  • If you cannot fix it yourself, hand engineering a precise, reproducible report; then confirm the fix on the vehicle.

Automate with AI

  • Use agentic coding workflows (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to build scripts and tools for flashing, health checks, and log analysis.

  • Be creative: find pragmatic solutions where no procedure exists yet, and share what works with the team.




What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree (electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer science, vehicle technology, or similar) or state certified Techniker / Meister with relevant practical experience. We hire for skills and drive, not titles.

  • First professional experience in vehicle electronics, E/E integration, ECU bring up, or prototype support in automotive, robotics, or autonomous driving. Strong graduates and young technicians with good projects are welcome.

  • Confident with Linux and the shell: SSH, services, logs, networking, file systems, installing packages. Scripting in Bash or Python.

  • Working knowledge of vehicle networks (CAN / CAN FD, Ethernet) and tools such as Vector CANoe / CANalyzer or open source equivalents.

  • Comfortable with measurement equipment and reading schematics and wiring diagrams.

  • You already use AI coding assistants or agentic workflows and want to push them further.

  • Creative, structured problem solver who documents what they do.

  • Fluent English; German is a strong plus. Driving license B.

Nice to have

  • ROS / ROS 2, Docker, Git.

  • HV qualification (e.g. DGUV 209-093).

  • Experience with autonomous vehicle sensors (lidar, radar, camera) and their calibration.

  • Own projects: microcontrollers, RC or model building, 3D printing, vehicle builds.

  • Defense or off road vehicle experience.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

title: Graduate Program (all genders)
description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

Every day, millions of travelers book buses, trains, ferries and transfers through platforms they know, and many of those bookings run on Distribusion. We connect hundreds of carriers with the world’s leading travel retailers, making ground transport as easy to book as a flight.


We’re looking for ambitious graduates who want real responsibility from day one. As part of our Graduate Program, you’ll join one of our core teams as an Analyst or Engineer, work on live products used across the globe, and learn alongside people who are building the infrastructure of ground travel.

Workplace: Berlin & Remote or willing to relocate to Berlin.

Where you could make your mark

Product Analyst roles:

  • Search Engine & Booking Platform: Build the core engine that returns fast, scalable search results and handles thousands of booking requests per second.

  • Supply & Integrations: Connect hundreds of external carrier APIs and help build robust, fault‑tolerant infrastructure that keeps bookings flowing.

  • Connectivity: Build enterprise‑grade integrations with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, CRMs and government authorities, with a strong focus on automation and innovation.

Partnerships Analyst roles:

  • Regional Partnerships: Work hands‑on with bus, rail, ferry and transfer operators and leading travel retailers in your region, guiding them from first integration to growing their bookings across our global network.

  • Corporate Partnerships: Bring ground transport into business travel by working with travel management companies, corporate travel agencies and booking tools, from technical onboarding to growing the partnership.

  • Performance & Growth: Dig into partner data, spot opportunities, and build the processes and automation that help us scale.


Who you are:

  • STEM or tech-related academic background - You’re a recent (or soon-to-be) graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Business/Information Systems, or a similar field.
    Analytical mindset & problem-solving     - You love digging into complex problems, understanding how things work, and turning ambiguity into clear, structured solutions.

  • Technical curiosity: You have a basic understanding of APIs, systems or digital products (through studies, internships or projects), and you’re excited to build with AI, whether that’s experimenting with new tools, prototyping ideas or putting AI to work on real problems in a high‑scale environment.

  • Strong communication - You can explain ideas clearly, whether talking to engineers, product managers, or business teams — and you enjoy bridging technical and non-technical worlds.

  • Collaborative & cross-functional - You like working with diverse teams and feel comfortable contributing to group projects, Agile teamwork, and shared problem-solving.

  • Fast learner & adaptable - You thrive in dynamic environments, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and stay resilient when things change or are not fully defined.

  • Ownership & ambition - You’re eager to take responsibility early, bring ideas to the table, and help shape processes that improve how products get delivered.


What you can expect:

  • Global reach & real-world impact - You help build software that enables travel for millions of people globally; your work supports real journeys across countries and continents, and makes transportation more accessible.

  • Cutting-edge tech in a high‑scale environment - From microservices and real-time search to AI-based content automation and cloud infrastructure, you’ll gain hands-on experience with many modern technologies and complex systems.

  • Fast growth & startup energy - Distribusion is rapidly expanding globally (70+ countries, hundreds of carriers/retailers), backed by strong funding — you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership early, learn fast, and grow with the company.

  • Variety: you can pick what excites you - Whether you like backend APIs, front‑end booking flows, data & analytics or product. There are many teams and disciplines where you can start, explore and specialise.

  • Meaningful mission — mobility & sustainability - By enabling efficient ground transportation (bus, rail, ferry) globally, Distribusion contributes to more sustainable travel alternatives to private cars or flights.

  • Global partnerships & industry exposure - You’ll collaborate with some of the biggest names in travel technology and national transportation, working directly with partners like Booking.com, Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • International team & inspiring culture - You’ll join a diverse, mission-driven team where talented people support, challenge, and learn from one another every day, a place to grow fast and make a real impact.

title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Solutions Integration Architect - Ariba
description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

You Will

You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization.

  • Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, build, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations.

  • Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs.

  • Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets.

  • Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments.

  • Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations.

  • Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

  • Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments including procurement platforms (Ariba).

  • Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI).

  • Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly.

  • Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols.

  • Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required.

  • Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge.

  • Comfortable working with API documentation.

  • Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors.

  • Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight

  • A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive.

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams.

  • Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Health Insurance

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 💻 Home office stipend

  • 🛜 Connectivity reimbursement

  • 🍼 Paid parental leave

  • 💸 Pension Contributions

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Platform Engineer, AI Enablement
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s AI Enablement team builds the shared platforms that help people across the company use language models and AI agents safely, reliably, and cost-effectively. As an early member of this platform team, you’ll help shape both the technical foundations and the standards for how AI-powered tools are built and operated across Wayve.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll design, build, and operate infrastructure for model access, agent runtimes, and observability. You’ll take projects from initial problem definition through technical design, deployment, and ongoing operation, partnering closely with security, IT, and engineering teams. You’ll also support teams adopting the platform by troubleshooting issues, documenting reusable patterns, and helping people understand what’s possible with the tools available.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • A governed, production-ready access layer for language models, including routing, authentication, cost controls, and auditability.

  • Secure infrastructure and reusable tooling for running agentic workflows in production.

  • Observability covering platform usage, cost, reliability, and performance.

  • Governance and safety controls that make AI use secure, compliant, and auditable.

  • Shared primitives, standards, and best practices that enable teams to build and deploy agents without creating one-off infrastructure.

  • Reliable, scalable deployments using cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have strong software engineering experience building APIs, services, or developer tooling.

  • You’ve built or operated platforms and infrastructure used by other engineering teams.

  • You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.

  • You’re familiar with LLM APIs and the surrounding ecosystem, such as model gateways, agent frameworks, MCP, or RAG.

  • You understand production observability, including metrics, tracing, and logging.

  • You take a security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, governance, and auditability.

  • You’re comfortable taking ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can communicate clearly through documentation and collaboration.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Recruiter screen

  • Competency Interviews

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Product Engineer, AI (Junior to Mid-Level)
description:
About us

At PastaHR, we're building the Agentic AI platform for enterprise recruiting teams.

Recruiters are drowning in applications, repetitive tasks, and manual processes. Meanwhile, agentic AI adoption in enterprise recruiting is still in its infancy. We're here to change that. Our platform integrates with existing applicant tracking systems like Workday and SAP, bringing AI-powered screening, scheduling, and custom AI agents into the workflows recruiters already use.

While other recruiting startups sell to startups, we bring AI into the real world. We serve enterprise customers across industries like retail, manufacturing, construction, logistics or financial services including companies like Aldi, Siemens, Swisscom or Vontobel.

We're a small, ambitious team with big goals.

Our team brings together people with strong backgrounds in technology, startups, and entrepreneurship. As a bootstrapped company, we grow through real commercial success. That means we're resourceful, move fast, and achieve a lot with a lean team.

At PastaHR, you'll take on real responsibility from day one, have a direct impact on our product and customers, and grow alongside the company. You'll be pushed outside your comfort zone, but you'll never be on your own.

If you thrive on ownership, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to build something that actually makes a difference, you'll feel right at home.

About the role

  • You will plan, build and ship AI-powered features and agents to be used by some of Europe's largest companies.

  • You will collaborate closely with our customers to improve and integrate AI agents into their daily workflows

  • Unlike at other companies, you will own projects end to end – even if as a junior (with the required support from the team)

  • You'll work across the stack, from frontend interfaces to AI agents and enterprise integrations, taking ownership from idea to production

Our tech stack:

  • Nextjs / React / Typescript / Shadcn / Tailwind/ AI SDKs / PostgreSQL / dbos

  • All the latest LLMs and Decision Models / Langfuse for observability and evals

  • Infra: AWS

What we're looking for

  • You must have finished your degree and are looking for a full-time position (this is not an internship).

  • You are a builder at heart. This means you built full-stack applications yourself and can showcase projects beyond university coursework.

  • You are highly skilled using AI coding agents. You use AI to move faster but take full responsibility for the code you ship.

  • You care deeply about user experience, have an eye for good design, and want to keep improving it.

  • You're curious, proactive, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

  • You have demonstrated ambition beyond academics through personal projects, internships, entrepreneurial ventures, or extracurricular activities.

  • You are willing to work in a hybrid setup with multiple days a week in our office in Zurich.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with TypeScript, React, and Node.js.

  • Experience with non-deterministic systems, especially LLM evaluations

  • Experience with durable execution frameworks such as dbos, Temporal etc.

  • Fluent in German (We work with companies in the DACH region, the better your German, the closer to the end user you can be.)

What we offer

  • Real ownership and impact from day one

  • Fast learning alongside experienced engineers and founders

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge AI and high token limits

  • Latest MacBook Pro

  • 26 vacation days per year (you can use flexibly)

PastaHR is for you, if:

  • You enjoy taking full ownership of your work and proactively driving topics forward.

  • You like working with the newest tools and finding the best solution to a problem.

  • You’re eager to learn quickly, grow in your role, and evolve with the company.

  • You want to help shape the company and see the real impact of your work.

PastaHR is not for you, if:

  • You don't want a challenge, learn a ton and grow with the company.

  • You need clear structures in the team and a lot of guidance.

  • Your preferred work environment consists primarily of remote work/home office.

  • You are in search of a more laid-back workplace.

The process

  1. Introduction Call (30 minutes): A casual conversation to get to know each other and discuss your background and interests.

  2. Technical Interview (45-60 minutes): Dive into technical skills and problem-solving.

  3. Personal Fit Interview (30-45 minutes): Meet one of our founders to explore alignment with our values and vision.

  4. Onsite Case Study (1–2 days): Join us at PastaHR to work on a case study, interact with the team, and experience our culture firsthand.

  5. Decision: We’ll get back to you promptly with our decision and next steps.

JawBuddy helps people with jaw pain, teeth grinding and TMJ problems through a guided exercise app. Our app measures jaw movement through the phone camera using computer vision and AR, so users see their progress in real numbers.

We are a small, funded health-tech team with paying customers in Germany. Next up: a B2B platform release in early 2027.

How this internship works

We offer this role only as a mandatory internship: you are enrolled at a Germany university and your study regulations require an internship. You send us a document from your university that confirms this.

The internship is on-site at our office in Leipzig, full-time, for 3 months. Start: as soon as possible.

We can't offer working-student contracts, voluntary internships, remote work or freelance work.

The role

You help us grow JawBuddy: in our B2C business today, and in our B2B business ahead of the platform release in early 2027.

What you'll do

Research and analyse our markets

  • Run market research and analyses on target groups, competitors and potential partners

  • Assess new opportunities and turn your findings into clear recommendations for the founders

Grow our B2C and B2B business

  • B2C: analyse customer feedback and help plan and run campaigns that win and keep customers

  • Enrolled at a German university with a mandatory internship in your study regulations (for example business administration, economics, health management or similar)

We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.

We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Benefits

  • Early team member with real ownership – your work ships to paying customers, not a demo

  • Employee stock options: you own part of what you build

  • New office in Zürich Kreis 5

  • Modern, AI-first toolchain – we invest in whatever makes you faster

  • Work directly with the founders

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Augment

Logistics is broken. Let's fix it.

We are a team of engineers, product designers, and customer champions building Augie, Augment's AI teammate for supply chain. Augie reasons and acts like a seasoned operator, automating the busywork of quoting, dispatch, tracking, billing, and more for freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors.

Our team has scaled billion-dollar companies, built delightful products, and powered billions in commerce. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to define how AI reshapes supply chain, apply today.

Overview

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps team. You'll own our deal desk, support territory planning, and run the reporting our sales leaders rely on every week as we grow from 12 AEs to more than 20. You'll also keep our data clean and handle the day-to-day work behind forecasting, quota administration, and commission calculations. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations.

Our GTM Motion

Our motion is outbound-led. SDRs prospect and qualify freight brokers, 3PLs, for-hire carriers, private fleets, and distributors before AEs run discovery and close. We sell across Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments, with six-figure ARR deals and buying committees that span operations, IT, and finance. Your deal desk and reporting work needs to hold up to that complexity.

What You'll Do

  • Own the deal desk: review pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, route approvals, and make sure every closed deal is booked correctly

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, and Legal so quotes and contracts move fast without surprises

  • Support territory planning: model coverage and capacity, manage account assignments, and keep regions and segments up to date as we roll them out, starting with Distribution

  • Own sales reporting: run the weekly forecast and pipeline reports leadership uses to call the quarter, and build dashboards for pipeline, conversion, bookings, and AE and SDR performance

  • Report contracted ARR and live, billing ARR side by side, and work with Finance so the numbers tie out

  • Keep HubSpot clean and reliable: own data quality, required fields, account ownership, and deal hygiene

  • Calculate commissions and support quota tracking, working with the Director and Finance

  • Help onboard new hires to our sales tools and processes, and document how things work

What We're Looking For

  • 2 to 4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Deal Desk at a B2B SaaS company

  • Hands-on experience running or supporting a deal desk, including pricing approvals and contract review

  • Experience supporting territory planning or account assignment

  • Hands-on CRM admin experience. We're on HubSpot, and experience there is a strong plus

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort with SQL or a BI tool

  • A detail person who cares when the numbers don't match and digs in until they do

  • Clear communication with sales leaders and reps, including pushing back when the data says otherwise

Bonus Points For

  • Experience in logistics, freight, trucking, distribution, or supply chain tech

  • Experience administering commission plans or quota models

  • Familiarity with Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Seamless.ai, Clay, or BI platforms

Why Join Us?

  • Competitive Salary + Stock Options

  • Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Benefits

  • Flexible PTO

  • Monthly stipend

About Augment

At Augment, we set out to create a fully autonomous AI platform that streamlines operations and reclaims the human element in logistics. Our founders recognized a pattern: talented professionals were stuck handling manual data entry, phone calls, and repetitive tasks, instead of focusing on high-impact problem-solving and strategic decision-making.

That insight became our missionâto free logistics professionals from busywork so they can focus on what truly drives business growth. Augment isnât just about efficiency; itâs about transforming an entire industry by empowering teams with AI-driven solutions that make logistics smarter, faster, and more adaptive.

Join us on this journey!

Augment is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity at our company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Product Feature Owner - Parking
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team

Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.

As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Parking functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific Parking features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

  • Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

  • Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

  • Partner with systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and supplier teams to shape the Parking sensor and compute architecture.

  • Drive integration and issue resolution across the Parking sensor stack, including ultrasonic sensors (USS) and surround-view cameras (SVCs).

  • Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

  • Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as customer priorities, platform constraints and the technology evolve.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Parking features, including Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist and Memory Parking.

  • Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

  • Translating sensor, compute and platform constraints into clear feature scope, performance targets and delivery trade-offs.

  • Leading integration across the Parking sensor stack, including USS and SVCs, and resolving sensor-specific performance and integration issues.

  • Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

  • Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have strong experience specifying and delivering Parking features from concept through to production, particularly Park Distance Control, Rear-AEB, Auto-Park Assist, Remote Park Assist or Memory Parking.

  • You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

  • You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on Parking feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You have experience defining and integrating automotive Parking sensor systems, including USS and SVCs, with practical knowledge of interfaces, calibration, diagnostics, supplier management and sensor-specific integration and performance issues.

  • You have delivered ADAS or Parking features on resource-constrained automotive SoCs, with a practical understanding of how compute, memory, bandwidth, latency and thermal budgets shape system architecture, feature behaviour, performance and customer experience.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product, systems, hardware, perception, platform, safety and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • Experience shipping complete Parking features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, NCAP, UNECE, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with AI/ML, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new Parking capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Germany office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency interviews (product ownership, customer collaboration and cross-functional delivery)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Parking and ADAS domain knowledge, feature delivery and product thinking)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Munich
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

  • Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 5+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

  • Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

  • Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

  • Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

  • Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Outreach Marketing Specialist (Maternity Leave Cover)
description:
We are looking for an Outreach Marketing Specialist II to join our Digital PR Team based in Poland, focusing on the German market. This high-impact role is ownership-driven at the intersection of media relations, SEO, and content marketing. The Specialist will execute and shape PR campaigns that enhance brand authority, secure press coverage, and drive organic growth for BOLD’s multiple B2C brands.

This position requires proven experience working with reporters to secure earned media, along with a deep understanding of the German media landscapes, PR trends, and digital best practices.

ABOUT THIS TEAM

Sitting in our Marketing Department, the Digital PR team works to raise brand awareness of BOLD brands through earned media. We collaborate with content and SEO teams to amplify brand presence in different international markets, including the UK, France, Poland, Germany, Spain, Brazil, and Italy. Our mission is to secure meaningful media coverage, build high-quality backlinks, and position BOLD brands as trusted voices in the career and job search space.

How do we work?

  • We have regular team meetings twice a week, while maintaining flexible working hours.
  • Our point of reference is our editorial calendar and individual goals, which we plan every quarter to guide our objectives and tasks.
  • We have regular 1-on-1 meetings with the acting manager to talk about campaign progress, strategy, and professional development.
  • We run our international markets and campaigns with a high degree of independence and autonomy.
  • We regularly share knowledge and experiences with team members across our different international markets.

Technologies/tools we use:

  • BuzzStream
  • Google Workspace
  • Ahrefs
  • Slack
  • Cision
  • Mention
  • Pollfish

Our recruitment process consists of the following stages:

  1. Recruiter Screening Call (60 min) – an initial conversation to discuss the role, your experience, and expectations.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min) – an opportunity to learn more about the role, discuss your experience in greater detail, and take part in a brief German language check.
  3. Senior Public Relations Director Interview (45–60 min) – a conversation about your media relations experience and approach.
  4. Panel Interview – a final meeting with team members, during which you'll present one of your previous PR campaigns.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Media Relations & PR Strategy

  • Own and direct the PR and outreach calendar in Germany, aligning with SEO and marketing objectives.
  • Write, edit, and pitch press releases, guides, surveys, and expert-driven content to German journalists and industry websites.
  • Develop and foster relationships with key German reporters, bloggers, and influencers to secure earned media coverage.
  • Translate and adapt US-based Digital PR content for the German audience, tailoring messaging to local media and cultural context.
  • Proactively identify PR opportunities based on market trends, competitor activity, and industry insights.

Outreach & Digital PR

  • Execute targeted outreach campaigns that generate press coverage and authoritative backlinks.
  • Balance Digital PR campaigns and traditional link-building to maximize visibility and impact.
  • Collaborate across PR, SEO, and content teams to create high-value assets that attract coverage and links.

Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Track outreach success rates, backlink acquisition, and press coverage.
  • Deliver regular reporting on earned media wins and link performance, with insights for optimization.
  • Provide quarterly performance reports with actionable recommendations.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 4+ years of media relations experience.
  • Proficiency in German and English.
  • Deep understanding of the German media landscape, PR trends, and best practices.
  • Strong writing, editing, and research skills, with attention to detail.
  • Familiarity with SEO principles and PR platforms such as BuzzStream, Cision, Pitchbox, or Ahrefs.
  • Ability to thrive independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

WHAT’S GOOD TO HAVE

  • Strong track record of pitching and securing German press coverage is a plus.
  • Familiarity with SEO principles, experience with traditional backlinking.
  • Background in agency or in-house PR with international collaboration.
  • Established relationships with reporters at major German media outlets and relevant industry publications.
  • Experience running original surveys to collect, analyze, and pitch data-driven insights.
  • Understanding of the career, job search, and job market landscape.

HERE’S A FEW OF OUR PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Salary range: 10 000 - 11 400 PLN gross (Employment agreement / Umowa o Pracę)

  • Private healthcare (Medicover, medical-only or medical with dental care individual package, 100% paid by BOLD).

  • Mental health support and resources.

  • Multisport Plus card (individual package, 100% paid by BOLD).

  • Udemy Business access.

  • 100% remote work (You must live in Poland or be willing to relocate to Poland to be considered for this role.).

  • Flexible work hours (Each team has their own working habits and obligatory meetings.).

  • Workation (up to 10 working days a year within EEA).

  • Equity in Company.

  • Optional office spaces in Warsaw, Krakow, Wroclaw, Gdansk, or Poznan.

  • Home office reimbursement (one-time equipment purchase, internet reimbursement).

  • Benefits cafeteria platform.

Pay range

10 000 zł—11 400 zł PLN

About Bold
We Transform Work Lives
As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.

We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion
We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. We don't discriminate regarding race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law.

Under San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance, qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

title: Paralegal
description:
What is Teamshares?

Teamshares Inc. (Nasdaq: TMS) is a tech-enabled acquirer of high-quality businesses that intends to be a permanent home for the businesses it acquires. Part holding company, part fintech, Teamshares programmatically acquires companies with $0.5 million to $5 million of EBITDA from retiring owners, integrates them with the Teamshares platform, and helps their employees earn company stock. Founded in 2019, Teamshares is on a mission to create $10 billion of new wealth for lower-income Americans through employee ownership—addressing a longstanding gap, as before Teamshares there wasn't an easy way for the small businesses that make up 98% of U.S. firms to become employee-owned.

What You Will Do:

  • Assist Teamshares’ legal team with various legal projects and responsibilities.

  • Support Teamshares’ obligations as a publicly traded company, including assisting with Section 16 filings (Forms 3, 4, and 5), Exchange Act and Nasdaq compliance matters, D&O questionnaires, insider trading policy administration, equity plan administration, and Board and annual meeting logistics.

  • Help manage the closing process in the acquisition of businesses. This includes acquisitions of varying types and legal structures (e.g., stock purchases, asset purchases, and mergers); coordinating and reviewing diligence deliverables such as lien, UCC, and title searches; and drafting and negotiating ancillary transaction documents (e.g., bills of sale, assignment and assumption agreements, secretary’s and officer’s certificates, payoff letters and lien releases, and escrow agreements).

  • Iterate on a document management and legal compliance system for each of Teamshares’ network companies, including corporate minute books, organizational charts, and governance records for the parent company and each subsidiary.

  • Help implement and maintain the employee ownership program in each Teamshares network company, including equity administration and cap table maintenance.

  • Develop thoughtful and innovative strategies to improve the existing acquisition process.

  • Collaborate with the product development team and drive continuous discussions of opportunities where software can be leveraged to augment efficiency and scale.

  • Support corporate governance matters for Teamshares and its subsidiaries, including preparing and maintaining materials for Board and committee meetings, drafting Board and stockholder/member resolutions and written consents, maintaining and coordinating receipt of good standing certificates, and maintaining minute books and equity records.

  • Form new subsidiaries in connection with acquisitions, including drafting and filing certificates of incorporation/formation, bylaws and operating agreements, organizational resolutions, and IRS Form SS-4 applications.

  • Support outside counsel and the Legal team on routine litigation and pre-litigation matters affecting Teamshares and its network companies, including responding to wage garnishments and income withholding orders, coordinating compliance with HR/payroll, and tracking litigation deadlines and maintaining litigation files.

  • Manage relationships with the registered agent, corporate filing agents, and other outside vendors; maintain the Legal team’s contract repository and compliance calendar (e.g., annual reports, franchise tax filings, and business license renewals); and assist with trademark and other intellectual property docketing.

What You Bring:

  • 8+ years of paralegal experience, including M&A transaction experience gained in a law firm setting as well as on the in-house legal team of a publicly traded company.

  • A paralegal degree, certificate or similar training is preferred, but not required.

  • Self-starter with strong communication and organizational skills.

  • Exceptional verbal, written and interpersonal communication capabilities.

  • Ability to take initiative and ownership of work streams and work independently.

  • Hands-on experience with most of the following:

  • Ability to manage and drive an M&A closing process (putting together signature pages, creating closing sets, overseeing closing checklists, etc.)

  • Capability forming legal entities (filing formation or incorporation documentation and SS4s, etc.), including in connection with the formation of new subsidiaries for acquired businesses

  • Prior experience drafting Board and Shareholder/Member Consents. Equity administration experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Experience with routine litigation and pre-litigation matters (e.g., garnishments, income withholding orders, subpoenas, and collections) is a plus.

  • Experience supporting the corporate governance and public-company compliance function of a publicly traded company (e.g., SEC/Exchange Act reporting, Section 16 filings, Board and committee support) is a plus.

  • Notary public commission is a plus.

  • Familiarity with legal technology and contract management tools (e.g., document automation and e-signature platforms) is a plus.

This role presents a fantastic opportunity for an individual who is self-driven and wants to be part of a mission-driven team where collaboration, work-life balance, trust and initiative (among other core values) are part of the fabric of the company. The paralegal will be an integral part of a legal team that is responsible for Teamshares’ transition as a newly-public company and the continued acquisition of small businesses. In addition, this role will collaborate with the product team to find and implement creative ways to improve and automate current processes.

Why You Should Join Us:

We believe in supporting every team member with a competitive salary and a generous benefits package, including equity for all employees, exceptional medical/dental/vision benefits plans for employees and their families, 401k plan, and paid parental leave. We value time off and actually take our vacations, and we have a healthy work-life balance culture that checks egos at the door and truly unplugs at the end of the day. We embody a growth mindset and provide the support you need to grow in your career.

Compensation
