title: Benefits Coordinator
description:
😎 Our Culture

Quantum Metric's number one objective is happy people, diverse and inclusive culture. We’re passionate about empowering our people to become the best version of themselves, offering coaching and training programs designed to accelerate their career in whatever direction they choose.

As a remote-first company, we understand the importance of building an engaged, diverse, and fun place to work. We hold regular company-wide events, seasonal challenges, and Quantum Metric sponsored local outings when Zoom becomes too much. We also have a number of Employee Resource Groups that provide spaces to discuss, share, and reflect on topics that impact us both inside and outside of work - from being new to SaaS or navigating it as a first-time parent, to overcoming the barriers faced as Black, Hispanic, Asian American and Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, LGBTQIA or other underrepresented backgrounds.

We are also passionate about the connections we build with our customers. You’ll not only work with some of the world’s most recognized brands, but build lasting relationships.

At Quantum Metric we value all types of experience and education and don’t expect you to meet every qualification for this position. We are most interested in the unique perspective you can bring and your ability to uphold our values of passion, persistence, and integrity.

🚀 About the Role

Quantum Metric is seeking an experienced Benefits Coordinator to join the People Operations team. In this role, you’ll own the day-to-day administration of our U.S. benefits programs.

You’ll handle key areas such as benefits enrollment, employee education, and vendor coordination, helping ensure a smooth and consistent experience across all offerings. This role reports to the Manager, People Operations and contributes to delivering competitive, compliant, and employee-focused benefits programs.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of U.S. benefits administration and a strong interest in expanding on their career within Total Rewards.

What you’ll do
As the Benefits Coordinator at Quantum Metric, you will be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of our Benefits Programs. This role will develop and administer all of QM’s Benefit packages, including healthcare, dental, vision, wellness programs, and 401(k). You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders, brokers, and vendors to keep programs running effectively and address employee needs.

🔧 Responsibilities

  • Be the subject matter expert for all benefits programming and leave administration
  • Administer benefit open enrollments, life events, and ongoing administration
  • Maintain benefits data within HRIS and carrier systems
  • Serve as the main point of contact for new hires and employee benefit questions
  • Create and maintain clear employee-facing benefits materials and resources
  • Audit benefits invoices and ensure accuracy across benefit billing and system data
  • Partner with brokers and vendors to maintain strong service and resolve escalations
  • Lead wellness initiatives and employee wellbeing programs
  • Own the administration of leave of absence and parental leave processes
  • Ensure compliance with US regulations (ERISA, COBRA, ACA, FMLA)
  • Review programs regularly and recommend improvements based on employee feedback and market trends

💡 Requirements

  • Bachelors or equivalent work experience preferred
  • 2-3 years experience in Human Resources
  • Expertise with HRIS systems (Paylocity and HiBob a huge plus)
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and navigate complex tasks autonomously
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion
  • Strong data management skills and proficiency in Excel

Compensation

Bonus eligible

Additional Information

💻 Recruitment Process

Note: This interview process is subject to change. End stage candidates are also given the optional opportunity to meet with an Employee Resource Group Member if that is of interest.

- Recruiter Screen (30 minutes)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

- Team Panel (30 minutes)
- COO Interview (15 minutes)

- CEO Interview (30 minutes)

🏆 Perks and Benefits

This will be the best group that you ever work with! We support one another through obstacles and succeed as a team. Your hard work will be well rewarded. Most importantly, you'll be strapped to a technology rocket ship bound for greatness! Your success at Quantum Metric will be a milestone in your career.

Group benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance (99% Medical base plan paid by the Company)

FSA, DCFSA, and HSA accounts

Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)

Telehealth options

Voluntary Life & AD&D, STD, LTD, Critical Illness and Accident

Wellness Perks - discounts on a top-rated fitness app and Healthy Rewards program.

Discounts on Pet Insurance

401k (with employer match) and Options / Equity

13 company holidays

Unlimited Paid Time Off

Sick leave

Parental/Adoption Leave

In addition to our more traditional benefits, we also offer great perks, a flexible work environment, and numerous resources for professional development and team building.

Promotional opportunities

Rewards and recognition programs

Robust onboarding and training program

One-time stipend for work-at-home employees

Monthly business expense stipend

Flexible work environments

Employee Discount Program (Perks at Work)

Employee Referral Program

Lead Referral Program

MacBook and awesome swag delivered to your door

Encouraging and collaborative culture

RECHARGE PROGRAM (after 3 years, disconnect for 3 weeks, no email/slack)

🐉 About Quantum Metric

As a leader in digital analytics, Quantum Metric helps organizations put customers at the heart of everything they do. Providing a simplified approach to monitor, diagnose and optimize the digital journeys that matter most, the Quantum Metric platform offers in-depth customer understanding, quantified and tied to core business objectives.

Today, Quantum Metric captures insights from 50 percent of the world’s internet users, supporting nationally recognized brands in ecommerce and retail, travel, financial services and telecommunications.

Quantum Metric has been named to the Inc 5000 and the Deloitte 500 for the last six-consecutive years, and has made the Best Places to Work lists by Glassdoor, BuiltIn, Fast Company and Forbes.

If the above role seems like a match and you’re interested in joining a team of people with exceptional potential from diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences, we want to hear from you!

title: Digital Engagement Specialist (CRM), IS-2210-11
description:
OPEN DATE: November 23, 2026
CLOSING DATE: December 23, 2026 * This announcement will close upon receipt of 200 applications or on the closing date, whichever occurs first.*
POSITION TYPE: Trust Fund
APPOINTMENT TYPE: Indefinite
SCHEDULE: Full Time
DUTY LOCATION: Remote *Salary will be set based on the selectee's official duty station and the applicable Federal pay schedule and locality pay table in effect at the time of appointment. *
Position sensitivity and risk
Non-sensitive (NS)/Low Risk
Open to all qualified applicants.

What are Trust Fund Positions?
Trust Fund positions are unique to the Smithsonian. They are paid for from a variety of sources, including the Smithsonian endowment, revenue from our business activities, donations, grants and contracts. Trust employees are not part of the civil service, nor does trust fund employment lead to Federal status. The salary ranges for trust positions are generally the same as for federal positions and in many cases trust and federal employees work side by side. Trust employees have their own benefit program, which may include Health, Dental & Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Transit/Commuter Benefits, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Annual and Sick Leave, Family Friendly Leave, 403b Retirement Plan, Discounts for Smithsonian Memberships, Museum Stores and Restaurants, Credit Union, Smithsonian Early Enrichment Center (Child Care), Flexible Spending Account (Health & Dependent Care).
Conditions of Employment
  • Pass Pre-employment Background Check and Subsequent Background Investigation for position designated.
  • Complete a Probationary Period.
  • Maintain a Bank Account for Direct Deposit/Electronic Transfer.
  • The position is open to all candidates eligible to work in the United States. Proof of eligibility to work in U.S. is not required to apply.
  • Applicants must meet all qualification and eligibility requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this announcement.

OVERVIEW

SI is a diverse museum and research complex dedicated to the increase and diffusion of knowledge. The Office of Digital and Innovation (ODI) is driving the future of how the Smithsonian advances its mission and connects with the world. ODI works centrally and within Smithsonian units to unlock the full potential of our collections and resources, better understand and serve our audiences, and pioneer innovative approaches to accelerate and scale our impact—all while empowering staff across the Smithsonian with the tools and skills they need to success in and ever-changing digital world.
The Smithsonian Institution’s Office of Digital and Innovation (ODI) is seeking a Digital Engagement Specialist (CRM) to lead and support enterprise digital engagement efforts across the Institution. This position manages Salesforce digital marketing and engagement processes, ensures compliance with governance and communication standards, and provides subject matter expertise on digital engagement strategies.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The selected candidate will advise stakeholders on best practices for marketing automation, subscriber preference and consent management, campaign testing, data governance, and customer engagement design patterns to optimize audience outreach and enhance the effectiveness of digital communications.
  • Configure, implement, and maintain Smithsonian's implementation of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including connections with other Salesforce components (e.g. Sales, Service, and Data Clouds), third party integrations, and configuration and administration of multiple business units.
  • Design, test, build, and showcase data integrations, queries, automations, journeys, and reports.
  • Support development of Marketing Cloud Personalization components (templates, content zones, third-party integrations, triggers, etc.)
  • Create and manage email campaigns, customer journeys, and personalized content.
  • Collaborate with SI-wide digital engagement teams to develop digital proficiencies, shared services, digital engagement journeys, channels, and automations.
  • Manage Smithsonian's Digital Marketing (Salesforce Marketing Cloud) processes, review governance and compliance in relation to Digital communications and engagement.
  • Provide guidance on best practices and design patterns related to digital engagement, preference/opt-in handling, automation, testing and data management.
  • Stay up to date with the latest Salesforce Marketing Cloud releases, features, and industry best practices to continuously improve the marketing automation capabilities of the organization.

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

Candidates may qualify for this position through a combination of education, demonstrated knowledge, and related professional experience.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Admin certification.
  • Proficient experience with Marketing Cloud, including Journey Builder, Email Studio, and Automation Studio.
  • Strong understanding of marketing automation principles and best practices.
  • Experience with HTML/CSS, SQL, and AMPscript for email template customization.
  • Excellent analytical skills to measure and optimize campaign performance.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage multiple projects.
  • Experience with Sales Cloud/Salesforce Lightning/Salesforce CRM.
  • Preferred: Experience working in Nonprofit and/or Federal environments
Education
To qualify at this grade level, you must possess one of the following:
  • A Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in computer science, engineering, information science, information systems management, mathematics, operations research, statistics, technology management, or a related field; OR
  • Three full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to a Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in one of the fields listed above; OR
  • A degree that included at least 24 semester hours in one or more of the fields identified above and required the development, implementation, adaptation, or management of information technology applications, systems, or networks.

Note: Applicants qualifying based on education must submit transcripts (unofficial transcripts are acceptable at the time of application; official transcripts may be required before appointment). Applicants whose education was completed outside the United States must be deemed equivalent to higher education programs of U.S. Institutions by an organization that specializes in the interpretation of foreign educational credentials. This documentation is the responsibility of the applicant and should be included as part of your application package.

Resumes should include a description of your paid and non-paid work experience that is related to this job; starting and ending dates of job (month and year); and average number of hours worked per week.

What To Expect Next: Once the vacancy announcement closes, a review of your resume will be compared against the qualification and experience requirements related to this job. After review of applicant resumes is complete, qualified candidates will be referred to the hiring manager.
Relocation expenses are not paid.

To learn more, please review the Smithsonian’s Accommodation Procedures.

title: Project Beid - Korean E-commerce Product Matching Annotator
description:
Responsibilities

- Review pairs of e-commerce listings and decide whether they are the same product and the same sellable variant, returning ACCEPT or REJECT.

- Compare key attributes such as brand, model number, size/capacity, color, quantity, and set composition, using product names, images, and listing pages, including Korean text embedded in images.

- For REJECT decisions, select the correct reason code(s) from the provided code list. List all applicable codes, and use OTHERS only when no other code fits, with an explanation.

- Handle special cases per project rules, such as missing or blocked pages, and variant options shown as swatches with none pre-selected.

- Record edge cases, uncertainties, and observations in the notes field.

- Keep input data unchanged and follow output formatting rules exactly (timestamps, uppercase decisions, exact code spelling, CSV quoting).

Requirements

- At native proficiency level of Korean.

- Able to read product titles, specifications, and text within images.

- Familiarity with e-commerce product data (SKUs, variants, bundles, gifts, capacity and quantity notation). Experience in merchandising, data annotation, or content moderation is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail, especially on subtle differences like model suffixes, volume, color, and count.

- Ability to apply rules consistently and document the reasoning.

- Proficiency with Excel/CSV.

VPN and Location Verification: What You Need to Know

1. Application and onboarding: no VPN. Please do not use a VPN when you apply or go through onboarding.

2. Production: VPN required. Once production starts, you will need to use a VPN. Opera browser is recommended. (Opera is a free built-in VPN and needs no extra installation.) We will send you setup instructions before production begins.

3. Which VPNs are allowed. Standard consumer VPNs are fine. High-risk proxies are not permitted.

4. Periodic checks in Production. For administrative reasons, we may occasionally ask you to access AI Trainer platform without your VPN so we can check your unmasked IP.

Compensation

title: Scrum Master
description:
Job Description – Scrum Master

Company: Lingaro Group

Role: Scrum Master

Location: India

Work Model: Remote
Competency: Data & AI / Technology Delivery

About Lingaro

Lingaro is a global Data and AI consulting partner helping organizations transform their businesses through data, analytics, cloud, and artificial intelligence solutions. We combine deep technology expertise with industry knowledge to help enterprises unlock the value of their data and accelerate digital transformation.

At Lingaro, we believe in collaboration, technology excellence, customer focus, and continuous learning.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Scrum Master to facilitate Agile delivery and enable high-performing, cross-functional technology teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Agile methodologies and Scrum practices, with exposure to technology-driven projects, preferably in Data Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud, or Software Development environments.

As a Scrum Master, you will act as a servant leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, removing impediments, coaching teams on Agile principles, and ensuring effective collaboration between technical teams, Product Owners, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint Retrospectives.

  • Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and maintaining a well-defined product backlog.

  • Ensure teams follow Agile and Scrum principles while continuously improving their delivery practices.

  • Identify, track, and remove impediments that affect team productivity and sprint commitments.

  • Monitor sprint progress, team velocity, burndown charts, and other Agile delivery metrics.

  • Work closely with engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, Delivery Managers, and business stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

  • Manage dependencies, delivery risks, and cross-team coordination.

  • Promote transparency, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within Agile teams.

  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile best practices and Scrum principles.

  • Support distributed and geographically diverse teams working in an international consulting environment.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of experience in IT, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as a Scrum Master.

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, and Kanban practices.

  • Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing Agile delivery processes.

  • Hands-on experience with Agile project management tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  • Experience working with cross-functional technology teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Ability to identify delivery challenges, manage dependencies, and proactively resolve impediments.

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Highly Preferred Qualifications

  • Scrum Master certifications such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM I/II), or equivalent.

  • Experience working in Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Data Analytics, or Cloud technology projects.

  • Familiarity with technologies and platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, and modern data platforms.

  • Experience working in IT consulting, professional services, or global technology delivery organizations.

  • Exposure to SAFe or other scaled Agile frameworks.

  • Experience managing multiple Agile teams or distributed delivery teams.

    • Key Competencies

  • Servant Leadership

  • Agile Mindset and Continuous Improvement

  • Effective Communication and Facilitation

  • Stakeholder and Conflict Management

  • Problem-Solving and Decision-Making

  • Collaboration and Team Empowerment

  • Delivery Focus and Accountability

title: Corporate Counsel, Commercial
description:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each memberâs life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries â from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets â including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review â as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity ð

As Corporate Counsel, Commercial, you will be the legal partner behind Carrotâs customer and vendor contracts. Day to day, you will negotiate, draft, and review a high volume of commercial agreements, including master services agreements, service level agreements, professional services agreements, and NDAs. You will partner closely with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions quickly, manage most matters from start to finish, and escalate high-risk issues when the moment calls for it.

This role is built for an attorney who pairs sharp legal judgment with practical business thinking. You will help move deals toward close while managing risk thoughtfully, supporting employers, health plans, and health systems around the world. You will join a collaborative Legal team and have support as you grow into greater independence and take on work with limited oversight.

Â 

What Youâll Own ð¼

In this role, you will:

  • Negotiate, draft, and interpret a wide range of commercial and vendor agreements, managing most contract matters from intake through signature.
  • Partner with Sales and other business teams to resolve redlines and customer questions efficiently and keep deal timelines on track.
  • Provide strategic legal advice to internal client groups, translating legal and regulatory risk into practical business recommendations.
  • Identify and explain operational and revenue-related risks, and escalate high-risk issues at the right time.
  • Manage a high volume of contracts at all times while protecting quality and turnaround speed.
  • Support privacy and data protection terms in commercial agreements, including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements.
  • Work across a complex, global matrix of collaborators to support Carrotâs growth.
  • Use contract lifecycle management and AI tools to improve the efficiency of legal research, drafting, and contract workflows.

Â 

What Success Looks Like Â ð

In your first 12â18 months, you will have:

  • Independently managed a high volume of commercial contracts from intake to signature with consistently timely turnarounds.
  • Become a trusted legal partner to Sales and other client groups, resolving redlines and customer questions efficiently.
  • Taken on increasingly complex and multi-party agreements with limited oversight.
  • Escalated high-risk issues proactively, with clear recommendations for the business.
  • Built working fluency in Carrotâs products, customer segments, and the global fertility and family-building landscape, and applied it to practical negotiating positions.
  • Improved contract workflows by making full use of Ironclad and AI-enabled tools.




About You â¨

You likely have:

  • A J.D. and membership in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 3+ years of legal experience, in-house and/or at a law firm, ideally with in-house transactional experience at a health plan or startup.
  • A strong grasp of contracting concepts and solid experience drafting, negotiating, and interpreting commercial and vendor agreements such as MSAs, SLAs, professional services agreements, and NDAs.
  • Experience counseling a sales organization.
  • The ability to analyze and advise on legal and regulatory risk, with creative solutions that support growth.
  • Flexibility, a willingness to work on a broad variety of legal matters, and comfort with ambiguity.
  • A record of strategic thinking and of working across a complex matrix of global collaborators, pairing strong legal analysis with practical business recommendations.

Â 

Nice to Have â­

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience drafting and negotiating commercial contracts with global companies.
  • Experience with complex multi-party commercial agreements and vendor agreement review.
  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle management software, especially Ironclad.
  • Experience using AI tools.
  • Knowledge of privacy laws including HIPAA, CCPA, and GDPR in the context of BAAs and DPAs.
  • Interest in fertility and reproductive health policy, and how it differs by country and culture.
  • Knowledge of the employee benefits, healthcare, and/or pharmaceutical industries.

Â 

Why This Role Matters ð§¡

Carrotâs contracts are how our mission reaches people. Every agreement with an employer, health plan, or health system shapes how well members around the world can access fertility and family-building care. In this role, you help Carrot say yes to growth in ways that protect the company, our customers, and the members we serve.

Because you will own most matters from beginning to end, your judgment directly affects deal velocity, customer trust, and revenue. You will be a visible, trusted partner to Sales and the broader business while helping a rapidly growing global company scale its commercial legal function.



Interview Process ð¤

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen â 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview â 30â45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews â 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation â 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Â 

Why Candidates Join Carrot ð

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

Â 

Â

Our benefits include comprehensive health and wellness coverage, retirement savings plans, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. This role is:

Base + equity roles:
Compensation for this role is structured as base salary plus equity, giving you ownership in Carrot's long-term growth. This role does not include an annual bonus or variable compensation.

  • Base Salary Range:Â  $140,000-$160,000

title: Vehicle Safety Operator
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Vehicle Operations Teams

 

Our world-class, diverse Vehicle Operations team is dedicated to testing and advancing our autonomous driving technology across Germany. As a Vehicle Safety Operator, you will be at the heart of our real-world AI development, running on-road experiments, providing actionable feedback, and upholding the highest safety standards in collaboration with our research and development teams.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Conduct on-road experiments and testing with our vehicles throughout Germany, ensuring all activities are safe and efficient.

  • Monitor artificial intelligence systems while driving, actively responding to any hazards to guarantee safe operation.

  • Evaluate vehicle and AI performance during tests, providing structured, expert feedback to engineering and research teams.

  • Support safety and engineering processes by identifying and reporting safety and vehicle maintenance issues.

  • Deliver real-world driving input to help train and refine our AI before public road testing.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Testing and evaluating autonomous vehicle technology in actual road scenarios.

  • Reporting system feedback and real-world driving insights to help improve our AI’s performance.

  • Maintaining safety standards, supporting incident reporting, and collaborating on issue resolution with engineering and safety teams.

  • Travelling nationally and internationally as required for tests and demonstrations.

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • Hold a full, clean German driving licence.

  • Have at least 5 years' driving experience, primarily in Germany, with no blameworthy insurance claims in the past three years.

  • Fluent in English and German.

  • Strong communicator who shows empathy and teamwork.

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.

  • Adaptable, flexible, and motivated to solve problems with innovative solutions.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite or equivalent (Google Suite).

  • Familiar with basic navigation, touchscreen gestures, typing, text editing, managing device settings, using basic apps, and troubleshooting.

  • Able to work scheduled shifts (Monday to Sunday, 40 hours per week, with a rota issued 4 weeks in advance; shifts include 06:30-15:00 and 14:30-23:00, weekend work required).

  • Will disclose any secondary employment as part of the application process.

  • Willing to complete a health check (before/after offer) and disclose any conditions affecting safe operation.

  • Able to pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol testing (including testing during onsite interview).

 

Desirable:

  • Experience in vehicle testing, AV environments, or technical demonstrations.

  • Knowledge of AV technology or autonomous systems.

  • Customer-facing or hospitality experience.

  • T1 and T2 Bertha certification.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

Important details about the role:

  • This is a 1-year Fixed Term Contract (FTC), based onsite at our office in Leonberg.

  • National and international travel is required.

  • Please consider your commute: if your one-way journey is over 1.5 hours, it may not be practical for this role.

  • On-site parking is currently available but cannot be guaranteed as the team grows.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Driving Licence Check

  • Drug & Alcohol Test and Driving Assessment

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Cloud Architect (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen.

Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen.

Eines dieser Ventures ist eine PaaS für Builder Companies auf Google Cloud: eine Plattform, auf der Unternehmen ihre eigene Software mit AI bauen und betreiben. Für ihre Architektur suchen wir jemanden, der Google Cloud besser kennt als wir beide zusammen.

Mit wem du arbeitest

Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet.

Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah.

Du gehörst zu unseren ersten Einstellungen und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den neuen Skill, der unsere CI/CD 100x besser macht.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere AI-PaaS auf Hunderte Enterprise-Kunden skalieren und betreiben können.
  • Du steuerst Agents. Die Guidelines und die Governance, nach denen sie Terraform, Pipelines und Code bauen, entwickelst du selbst. So skalieren wir unsere Software Factory.
  • Wir treffen die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen der Plattform gemeinsam, unter deiner Führung.
  • Du arbeitest am Produkt. In Beratungsprojekte holen wir dich für Strategiefragen oder wenn ein Team nicht weiterkommt.

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Cloud. Du hast dort Plattformen entworfen, gebaut und in Produktion betrieben.
  • Du bist die Person, die gefragt wird, wenn bei Google Cloud sonst niemand weiterweiß.
  • Du könntest jede Ressource selbst in Terraform schreiben. Du lässt das Agenten machen und bist das Mastermind hinter deiner Agent Fleet.
  • AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby. Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware.
  • Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden.
  • Du willst jeden Tag dazulernen und kannst mit Feedback umgehen.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Keine Limits beim Werkzeug. Tokens, Hardware, Software: Du bekommst, was du für sehr gute Arbeit brauchst. Wir sehen das als Arbeitsmittel und diskutieren nicht über Budgets.
  • Ein Venture, das du mit aufbaust. Die PaaS ist ein eigenes Produkt neben unserem Kundengeschäft. Du bist früh dabei und übernimmst dort eine entscheidende Rolle.
  • Kunden mit Anspruch. Konzerne und große Mittelständler, die wirklich umbauen wollen, Private-Equity-Portfolios und Startups. Was wir in diesen Projekten über Builder Companies lernen, fließt in die Plattform.
  • Büro in der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag zusammen vor Ort, mit Blick über die ganze Stadt.

Das passt nicht, wenn

  • du lieber allein im Homeoffice sitzt, als mit uns zusammen zu bauen.
  • du klare Prozesse und ein fertiges Ticket-Board erwartest.
  • du Terraform lieber selbst tippst, als es Agenten schreiben zu lassen.
  • du AI für einen Hype hältst.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und erklär uns deine Vision dafür, wie man state-of-the-art Enterprise-Cloud-Architekturen vollständig durch Agents aufbauen und betreiben kann.

So geht's weiter

  • 30 Minuten Call
  • Ein halber Tag bei uns in der HafenCity: schnacken, essen, zusammen etwas bauen
  • Danach entscheiden wir. Ja oder nein, schnell.

title: Account Executive - DACH
description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

We are seeking a motivated and high-performing Account Executive with experience in enterprise sales as we turbo charge our revenue engine. As an AE on the enterprise team, you will own the selling of the Primer suite of products from end to end.

With a consultative approach, you will lead the sales cycle with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CFOs, and VP / Director level functional leads. You will also drive the Sales strategy by owning all aspects of the sales cycle from prospecting to discovery to close. This will include cross-functional work to develop the customer strategy and contribute to other revenue initiatives.

The Enterprise team at Primer is focused on both Strategic and Enterprise accounts. We work with founders and executives across a wide variety of verticals to gain an in-depth understanding of their business.

 

🔍 What will you be doing?

  • Own and manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting to closing, focusing on enterprise-level accounts.

  • Build a robust pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, and strategic partnerships.

  • Develop tailored sales strategies to engage key decision-makers and demonstrate the value of Primer’s platform.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success, to deliver exceptional customer experiences, update cross-functional teams with feedback from prospects, continue to hone our Ideal Customer Profile and action upon unique insights derived from your knowledge of our customers.

  • Contribute to team projects focused on developing and refining our sales process and playbooks. Staying informed on industry trends and payment innovations to provide valuable insights to clients.

  • Provide consultative selling to identify customer challenges and present innovative solutions.

  • Accurately forecast sales performance and maintain detailed records using CRM systems.

     

👀 What we’d love to see:

  • Driven to consistently exceed goals and expectations.

  • A go-getter, with a bias towards action and the ability to produce results in fast-paced, highly ambiguous situations.

  • Proactive, improving existing processes and developing best practices.

  • A strategic negotiator, with a passion for closing deals.

  • A life-long learner

  • Curious about prospects, their needs, and how Primer can help.

  • Energetic and bring a positive attitude to everything you do.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

description:
About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

  • 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto

  • ~110 people on the team in Munich

  • €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You open Italy for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on.

Why this role exists

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Italy is one of our expansion markets. It has a broad industrial base, from automotive suppliers to machinery and food production, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Italy from there.

Why your role matters

  • A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos.

  • You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation.

  • You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Italy.

  • You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won.

  • Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go.

  • Not a remote role: You build Italy from our Munich office and travel into the market.

Your tasks

  • Open up Italy end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Spanish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth.

  • Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing.

  • Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market.

  • Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline.

  • Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

  • Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact

  • Languages: Fluent, business-level English and Italian. German is a strong plus

  • Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate

Core strengths

  • Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet

  • Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline

  • Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run

  • Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externally through brand, network and reference logos, internally through the playbook and the case for the market

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • €1,500+ learning budget per year

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro call with our Chief of Staff

  2. Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

  3. Get-to-know call with the AE you’d be working alongside

  4. Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.


⚖️ About our Legal Team

Wayve’s Legal Team enables the business to achieve its goals while appropriately identifying and managing legal risk. This role sits within our Commercial Legal team, reports to the Managing Counsel, and will play an important role as Wayve scales globally and brings embodied AI technology into real-world deployment.

Based in London, you’ll work closely with commercial, procurement, engineering, product, privacy, People and Fleet Operations teams on a broad range of commercial and cross-border matters. You’ll have significant ownership and autonomy, helping stakeholders understand legal and commercial risks and finding practical paths forward in areas where precedent and market practice may still be developing.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll independently manage a broad range of day-to-day commercial legal matters while partnering closely with colleagues across the business. You’ll draft and negotiate agreements, advise on IP, AI, data, privacy and employment matters, and support strategic initiatives, international expansion and new product deployments.

This is an opportunity for a commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working at the intersection of law, AI, product innovation and operational scale. You’ll need to be comfortable exercising judgement in a fast-moving environment, clearly communicating risk and helping the business find solutions rather than simply identifying obstacles.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a broad range of commercial agreements, from supplier, software/SaaS, services and other operational contracts through to bespoke agreements with OEM customers and Tier 1 suppliers involving significant IP, data, privacy and other technology-related issues.

  • Advising on intellectual property, AI and data usage, including data used for AI development and training, alongside other members of the Legal team and external counsel where required.

  • Working through novel and emerging legal questions at the intersection of law and AI, including areas where legal frameworks, precedent and market practice are still developing.

  • Advising the People team on employment and HR matters relating to Wayve’s global workforce, working with local counsel where specialist jurisdictional advice is required.

  • Advising on data protection and privacy, including the use and sharing of data in connection with Wayve’s products, commercial relationships, and AI development and training.

  • Supporting strategic initiatives, international expansion and new product deployments from a commercial legal perspective.

  • Supporting Fleet Operations and other operational teams in connection with the operation, testing and deployment of Wayve’s vehicle fleet across international markets.

  • Building and improving scalable legal processes, templates, playbooks and governance structures to support Wayve’s growth and increasing contracting volume.

  • Educating and enabling stakeholders on commercial risk, contracting best practices and legal processes, while supporting other members of the Legal team.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You are a qualified solicitor in England and Wales.

  • You trained at a leading law firm and have approximately 2–4 years of relevant post-qualification experience, although we are open to candidates with more or less experience.

  • You have strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, including procurement, supply chain, technology and vendor contracts.

  • You are comfortable negotiating directly with commercial counterparties and can communicate legal positions clearly and pragmatically.

  • You have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills and can distil complex legal issues into clear explanations of legal and commercial risk for non-legal stakeholders.

  • You have experience supporting strategic commercial transactions and working closely with business stakeholders in fast-moving, technology-driven environments.

  • You exercise strong commercial judgement, assessing legal risk in the context of broader business objectives and providing practical, solutions-oriented advice.

  • You have experience advising on employment matters affecting a global workforce, or are willing to develop experience in this area, including navigating a fast-paced employment environment.

  • You can operate autonomously on day-to-day matters, take initiative and exercise sound judgement about when to escalate.

  • You have experience partnering cross-functionally and can communicate effectively with both legal and non-legal experts.

  • You have strong organisational and prioritisation skills and can manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities.

  • You’re enthusiastic about getting stuck into a broad range of legal matters, including areas outside your existing experience, and are comfortable tackling novel questions where precedent may be limited.

  • Experience within automotive, mobility or the broader technology sector is a major plus, particularly at an OEM, Tier 1 supplier or similarly complex engineering-led organisation.

  • Experience supporting OEM, strategic partnership or other large-scale B2B transactions involving hardware, software, data or integrated technology solutions is a plus.

  • Exposure to AI, data or autonomous vehicle-related legal issues is a plus.

  • Cross-border commercial advisory experience across the UK, US, Europe and Japan is a plus.

  • Experience supporting commercial or employment matters in Germany, including familiarity with the German legal and regulatory environment and working with German stakeholders and local counsel, is a plus.

  • Experience helping automate and scale legal processes, templates or commercial legal functions is a plus.

Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics or AI would be valuable, but it is not essential. We are most interested in strong foundational commercial skills, sound judgement and a proven ability to navigate complex legal landscapes in a fast-moving environment.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 – Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our London office. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Some international travel may be required.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency interviews (Hiring Manager Interview and team interview) (90 mins)

  • Deep-dive interviews (Presentation) (60 mins)

  • Final interview (30 mins)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you:

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Applied AI Architect, Large Enterprise
description:
About the Team

The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.

You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.

  • Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.

  • Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

  • Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.

  • Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.

  • Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

  • Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.

  • Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.

  • Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

  • Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

  • Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.

  • Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.

  • Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.

  • Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.

  • Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.

  • Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.

  • Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.

  • Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.

  • Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.

  • Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

About the role

As a core member of our Sales team, you’ll connect with a wide range of prospects and spark their interest in our authentication tech. You’ll be on the front lines of our growth engine, partnering with AEs and other BDRs to uncover opportunities, start meaningful conversations, fuel a steady pipeline of qualified leads, and own the full lifecycle for smaller deals.

What you'll do

As a Business Development Representative, you’ll focus on getting companies excited about our product. You’ll be reaching out to prospects across every level - from procurement managers and lead engineers to heads of anti-fraud, platform owners, CTOs, CPOs, and even CEOs. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Generating new sales opportunities for Prelude

  • Identifying companies and people to target within your verticals/territories

  • Cold calling and emailing as well as experimenting with other channels to find new leads

  • Qualifying leads and pitching Prelude's value proposition

  • Closing smaller deals independently

  • Maintaining a clean CRM

  • Improving processes as we scale our business

About you:

  • You have 6 months to 1 year of BDR or sales experience, ideally selling a technical product at a startup, scale-up, or SaaS company

  • You can handle the friction and challenges of cold calling and outbound prospecting

  • Solid understanding of qualification fundamentals

  • Able to understand technical concepts and translate them into business terms

  • A proactive mindset, with a drive to start conversations, build momentum, and close deals

  • Structured and rigorous in managing your pipeline, CRM hygiene, and performance metrics

  • You know your way around HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Apollo, RingOver, or Kaspr

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, taking initiative and finding solutions

  • Strong interpersonal skills and an excellent team player

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn by doing

  • Fluency in selling a technical product in German

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package (base + uncapped commission)

  • Comprehensive health insurance plan

  • Urban Sports Club gym membership

  • 100% transport subsidised

  • Swile meal vouchers

  • Pet-friendly office environment

  • Free snacks and drinks in the office

title: Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Mechanical Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper all the way to the factory floor and live field deployment.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedised, autonomous deployment infrastructure that takes our larger platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad (alongside a Team Lead, another Mechanical Engineer, a Hardware Engineer, and a Software Engineer), you will act as an end-to-end technical owner. Your work spans defining system specifications, sizing heavy structures and high-acceleration systems, managing budgets and suppliers, and getting hands-on in the workshop and field to stress-test hardware to failure.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Clean-Sheet Design: Architect, design, and prototype ruggedized, unmanned launch systems from scratch, taking hardware from initial concept through field test rigs to deployable systems.

  • Kinematics Power Sizing: Size and integrate high-acceleration hydraulic, pneumatic, or spring-loaded actuation systems, high-speed release mechanisms, and custom dampening systems capable of handling extreme dynamic loads.

  • Autonomous Launch Operations: Design reliable mechanical systems capable of operating independently in harsh, remotely supervised environments—handling self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and system resets.

  • Structural Engineering & Validation: Perform hand calculations and FEA to size heavy-duty structural weldments and moving assemblies, accounting for weld fatigue, shock, and sudden violent loads.

  • Testing & Prototyping: Build custom test benches and field rigs to validate designs, running physical stress tests to failure and iterating rapidly on hardware.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Flight Dynamics to define launch requirements, and work alongside Hardware and Embedded Software engineers to synchronize mechanical actuation with automated launch code.

  • Supplier & Project Ownership: Manage project budgets, timelines, and technical documentation (2D/3D CAD, BOMs, test reports) while partnering with suppliers on heavy-precision machining and series production.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Mechanical & Structural Design: Proven track record designing large-scale, heavily loaded machinery, structural weldments, and rugged mechanisms from scratch (ideally in aerospace, defense, heavy equipment, or robotics).

  • Kinematics Expertise: Deep hands-on experience sizing and designing moving assemblies, high-speed release mechanisms, and pneumatic or hydraulic circuits (cylinders, accumulators, valves) under high-acceleration forces.

  • CAD & Structural Analysis: High proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and structural validation using both hand calculations and FEA for dynamic and fatigue load cases.

  • Manufacturing & Sourcing: Strong command of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) across heavy-precision machining, welding, and industrial fabrication, with experience sourcing custom components and managing external suppliers.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership—equally comfortable defining technical specs, managing budgets, turning wrenches in the workshop, and running live field tests.

  • Communication & Mission Alignment: Clear written and verbal communication to document complex engineering decisions, paired with full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, pace, and growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
