title: Heavy- Duty Automation Engineer
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Heavy-Duty Automation Engineer on Harmattan AI's Launcher team in Lausanne, you will take a clean-sheet, fully autonomous launch system from a blank sheet of paper to live flight tests by simulation, prototype testing and field testing.

Our Launcher team builds the ruggedized, unmanned deployment infrastructure that takes our larger autonomous platforms from storage to flight at a moment's notice. Operating in a fast-paced startup environment within a tight-knit, cross-functional squad, you will own the entire control, automation, and safety architecture end-to-end.

Your work spans defining system specifications, selecting controllers, sensors, and high-speed valves, managing external suppliers, and getting hands-on programming PLCs, wiring prototypes, and tuning closed-loop characteristics and motion controls in the workshop and field.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Control & Safety Architecture: Architect, specify, and own the complete control-system work package from initial concept through commissioning and live flight tests by simulation, prototype testing and field testing.

  • PLC & Safety Programming: Develop robust industrial PLC and safety PLC control logic to govern fully autonomous, remotely supervised operations—including self-deployment, automated launch sequences, and autonomous aircraft reloading.

  • High-Acceleration & Precision Control: Select, integrate, and tune motion control systems (controllers, sensors, proportional/high-speed valves) capable of managing both high-precision positioning and extreme launch acceleration.

  • Machine Safety & Risk Assessment: Define safety standards, perform risk assessments, and implement hardware/software interlocks and performance levels for high-energy, unmanned outdoor equipment.

  • Hands-On Commissioning & Field Testing: Wire, calibrate, and commission control hardware on prototype test rigs and deployable systems, troubleshooting and iterating rapidly during live field trials.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Mechanical, Flight Dynamics, and Operations teams to synchronize mechanical actuation, flight requirements, and autonomous launch sequences.

  • Supplier & Documentation Ownership: Manage external component suppliers and integrators, maintain up-to-date electrical/control schematics, specifications, and commissioning documentation, and drive system reliability.

Candidate Requirements

  • Heavy-Duty Automation & Control Design: Proven experience designing, programming, and commissioning complex, heavy-duty automated machinery from scratch.

  • PLC & Safety Systems Expertise: Deep hands-on experience programming industrial PLCs and safety PLCs (e.g., Siemens, Beckhoff, or equivalent), including machine safety standards, risk assessments, and safety interlock design.

  • Electrical Cabinets & DAQ Architecture: Demonstrated proficiency in layout, wiring, and assembly of industrial control enclosures, alongside real-time data acquisition and test systems (e.g., National Instruments PXI platforms).

  • Hydraulic & Motion Control: Strong practical command of closed-loop characteristics and motion control, high-precision positioning (e.g., automated handling/reloading), and high-acceleration actuation.

  • Hardware Integration & Commissioning: Comfortable getting hands-on with electrical wiring, sensor calibration, valve selection, and field troubleshooting on ruggedized outdoor prototypes.

  • Supplier & Work Package Management: Experience owning automation work packages, sourcing specialized or custom fit-for-purpose control hardware, and managing external vendors.

  • True "Builder" & Startup Mindset: Thrives with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced environment—equally comfortable architecting control loops, wiring test benches, and supporting live field deployments.

  • Communication & Languages: Fluency in English required (French is a plus), with clear technical documentation skills and full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and growth

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

We are building industry-defining accounting and finance software. We are looking for a Deployment Associate to join our deployment team, keep customer implementations organized and on-track, and support Deployment Leads transitioning finance teams onto Rillet.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career who has the structure and follow-through to run the details of a complex project, and who wants to learn ERP implementation and AI native accounting from the people who lead it. You may come from an implementation or consulting firm, a Big 4 advisory or audit practice, a finance or operations team at a SaaS company, or a project coordination role in a technical environment. You will work alongside Deployment Leads, who own solutioning and the design decisions behind each implementation, and you will take on the project management, coordination, and hands-on support that get every launch over the line.

You will combine strong organizational instincts with curiosity and a customer-first mindset, tracking details, flagging risks early, and learning how configuration, data migration, integrations, testing, and go-live fit together. This role is a clear path to Deployment Lead: as you build experience, you take on more solutioning and begin leading deployments of your own.

We're primarily looking for teammates who are based near our New York City or San Francisco offices, or open to relocating. For this role, we're also open to remote candidates based anywhere in the United States. Our hybrid schedule brings office-based team members together in person on Tuesdays and Thursdays, plus one additional flexible day each week. Some roles may spend more time in the office depending on the needs of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Assist customer implementations with AI at the center: use Rillet's AI tools and agents to handle the work that used to be manual, including project plans, status updates, call recaps, and follow-ups, so your time goes to judgment and customers

  • Bring accounting and human judgment to AI-driven data migration:

    • Map legacy charts of accounts, dimensions, and entity structures from legacy ERPs into Rillet

    • Migrate historical financials by preparing and validating opening balances, historical trial balances, and journal entry loads, and tying them out to the customer’s prior books

    • Configure revenue recognition under ASC 606: turn customer contracts into products, performance obligations, and revenue schedules, and check deferred and recognized revenue against the customer’s existing waterfall

    • Build go-live reconciliations: tie AR, AP, bank, deferred revenue, and other subledgers to the GL in audit-ready workpapers, with review from a Deployment Lead

  • Improve the tools as you use them: spot where an AI workflow falls short, refine prompts and skills, and build new automations and agents on Rillet's API that make the next deployment faster

  • Test configuration, integrations, and system settings with AI-assisted checks, and document what you find so the whole team can reuse it

  • Be a responsive, trusted point of contact for customers during onboarding, using AI to get them answers faster and routing the rest to the right teammate

  • Learn from Deployment Leads by shadowing discovery, solutioning, and go-live sessions, and see how they turn complex accounting requirements into practical solutions

  • Help shape our deployment strategy: stay on top of trends in fintech, AI, and accounting, test new approaches on live implementations, and bring recommendations to Deployment Leads and leadership

  • Capture what works across deployments as playbooks, templates, and shared workflows the team can use on every launch

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to turn customer feedback and AI findings into product improvements

  • Identify risks and blockers early and escalate them before they affect the timeline, and take on larger workstreams over time as you grow toward Deployment Lead

Who We're Looking For

  • 1–3 years in ERP implementation, accounting, audit, systems consulting, finance transformation, or project coordination (e.g., Big 4 or implementation firms)

  • Background in SaaS, high-growth technology companies, or implementation/consulting environments is a plus

  • Exposure to ERP systems (NetSuite, Oracle, Sage, etc.), including requirements, configuration, data migration, or go-live; leading these end to end is not expected

  • Working understanding of core accounting workflows (close, reconciliations, ASC 606) and curiosity about how they translate into systems

  • Customer-facing with strong communication skills and the judgment to grow into stakeholder management

  • Systems-minded with solid project management skills; able to keep multiple workstreams organized

  • Comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and highly detail-oriented

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams

Compensation

Your compensation tier is based on your primary work location. Final compensation within the applicable range will depend on factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and the scope of the role. This role is also eligible for equity and benefits.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

title: Customer Experience Associate
description:
Customer Experience Associate

Peerspace · Customer Experience · Entry level New Graduates apply!

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Over $500M has been transacted through the platform, and our investors include GV (Google Ventures) and Foundation Capital.

Our people are the heart of Peerspace. We are a team that values inclusion and working cross functionally. Our strategy and objectives are clear and we support one another to exceed expectations. We believe that a healthy company culture creates an environment where people are excited to come into work everyday and contribute to building a successful organization.

About the role

Most routine questions get answered before they ever reach a person. What's left are the conversations that actually need one: a host and a guest who remember the same booking differently, a photographer whose shoot starts in three hours and the space just fell through, a situation where we don’t have a policy in place to resolve.

That's the work. As a Customer Experience Associate, you'll handle the cases that require judgment, empathy, and a bit of creative problem solving; and in the process you'll learn how a two-sided marketplace actually works, from the inside out.

What you'll do

  • Work a queue of guest and host conversations across chat, email, phone, and SMS, focused on the cases that were routed to a person for a reason.

  • Resolve booking issues, mediate misunderstandings between hosts and guests, and process cancellations and adjustments accurately.

  • Use our AI assist tools and knowledge base to draft and check responses; then edit for accuracy and tone. You're the one who decides what actually gets sent.

  • Look for chances to surprise and delight someone, and take them.

  • Flag recurring issues, confusing policies, and product friction to Specialists and leadership so they get fixed rather than re-answered.

  • Hit response-time and quality targets while keeping careful, complete case notes.

  • Show up for your team: standups, Slack etc… be a part of the culture that makes this a stellar place to work.

What we're looking for

You lead with empathy and keep the customer's interest front and center, even when the answer is no. You write clearly and warmly, and you care about grammar and tone. You can carry a case all the way to resolution without being chased, and you know the difference between a call you should make yourself and one you should escalate.

You're comfortable with technology and genuinely curious about working alongside AI tools. You are confident enough to use them well, but skeptical enough to check their work. New tools and policy changes don't rattle you. You can read your own queue and quality metrics and do something useful with what they tell you.

On paper, that usually looks like:

  • 1–2 years experience in customer service, hospitality, support, or something adjacent

  • Bachelors degree recently acquired

  • Strong writing skills with real attention to detail.

  • A sense of humor and genuine enthusiasm for helping people.

  • Bonus points if you have third party marketplace experience.

  • Additional bonus points for any experience with Intercom.

Schedule - 4 week rotation:

Monday - Friday; 8 hours/day EST hours. Looking for someone who can work either 9-6 Eastern or 8-5 Central.

This role includes a rotating weekend shift. You'll work one-two weekend days (Saturday or Sunday) a month as part of a team rotation, with a corresponding weekday off to keep your schedule balanced.

The hourly rate for this role is $25.00/hour.

Peerspace is proudly certified as a Great Place to Work™ and we're a remote first company with team members located in cities around the globe. Beyond competitive salary and equity compensation, we provide a range of benefits and perks, including:

● 100% employee coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

● Discount on all Peerspace bookings

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. All legitimate communication from Peerspace will come from an official @peerspace.com email address. We do not contact candidates through personal email accounts, third-party messaging apps such as WhatsApp or Microsoft Teams, or through the Peerspace platform's internal messaging system. All interviews are conducted only by phone or Zoom, and we will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information such as your Social Security number or bank details during the early stages of the hiring process. If you receive any message that seems suspicious or does not align with these practices, please contact us immediately at help@peerspace.com so we can investigate. We only post our job openings and process applications, through our official careers page at https://jobs.lever.co/peerspace.

Compensation

title: Certificate Authority Program Steward
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage Mozilla’s root store: Make root store management your primary responsibility, through public review processes, and policy and audit evaluations and using certificate analysis tools, the Common CA Database (CCADB), to process root inclusions, trust changes, and removals and maintain accurate trust and revocation data.
  • Evaluate CA compliance and investigate incidents: Review certificates, CA policies, audit reports, and incident responses. Identify gaps, ask precise follow-up questions, assess corrective actions, and support informed trust decisions.
  • Develop security policy and standards: Contribute to Mozilla’s Root Store Policy, program guidance, and CCADB and CA/Browser Forum requirements through technical analysis, clear drafting, and constructive public discussion.
  • Coordinate work and build program expertise: Collaborate with CAs, Mozilla engineers, auditors, and other root store operators to resolve issues and advance projects. Work closely with the CA Program Manager, document processes and decisions, and take on increasing responsibility.
  • Improve tools and automate CA program tasks: Maintain and enhance supporting tools and workflows. Use AI coding assistants and software tools to streamline certificate analysis, compliance review, data reconciliation, reporting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and human review.

What you’ll bring:

  • Understanding of the Web PKI and internet security: Working knowledge of digital certificates, public key cryptography, TLS, certificate chains, and revocation, including how technical requirements and CA practices establish trust. Awareness of emerging threats and developments, including post-quantum cryptography, and an interest in evaluating their implications for browser trust and CA operations.
  • Practical software engineering and automation skills: Experience developing, maintaining, testing, and debugging tools or services using existing codebases, APIs, structured data, Git-based workflows, and cloud applications.
  • CA compliance and audit evaluation: Ability to critically evaluate Certificate Policies and Certification Practice Statements (CP/CPS), independent audit reports, and incident analyses against applicable requirements. Familiarity with industry requirements and WebTrust and ETSI audit frameworks and the ability to identify gaps, assess supporting evidence, and formulate precise follow-up questions.
  • Analytical judgment and program management: Ability to investigate technical evidence, interpret specifications and policy requirements, and reach evidence-based conclusions. Prioritize competing requests, coordinate stakeholders, and follow complex issues through to resolution.
  • Clear communication and effective collaboration: Excellent written communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, write precise documentation and constructive questions, guide public discussions, and navigate disagreement professionally. Work effectively with distributed teams and external stakeholders, seek feedback, and share knowledge while developing broader technical and program expertise.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Account Executive, Field Sales
description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

About the Role

We’re hiring an Account Executive to win early customers in the luxury goods / watch dealer market, plus closely related high value, high trust SMB verticals. This is a field-first, relationship-driven role. You will spend a meaningful chunk of time traveling to meet customers in person, build trust quickly, and close.

This is a founder-adjacent role on a small, collaborative team. You will help shape the playbook as we move fast in a competitive landscape.

What You’ll Do

  • Own new revenue for Fin in the luxury goods / watch dealer segment and adjacent industries, from first touch through close and early expansion.

  • Build trust in person through store visits, dealer networks, dinners, and industry conferences.

  • Prospect and develop pipeline through a mix of outbound, warm intros, events, and your own network.

  • Run targeted discovery to uncover payment pain points, accounting workflows, and operational constraints.

  • Demo and position Fin clearly to sharp, no-nonsense operators, then handle objections and keep momentum.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact during onboarding, ensuring customers achieve platform proficiency and understand compliance requirements.

  • Act as a trusted partner and go to resource for customers, following up with customers to promote activity on the platform.

  • Work closely with founders, product, ops, and compliance to turn field feedback into improvements, messaging, and repeatable process.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent and sustained success in closing new accounts in the target market.

  • Building a repeatable field motion that converts skeptical prospects into active customers.

  • Creating a growing pipeline through in-person relationship building and conference execution.

  • Operating as a trusted industry fixture, creating deep relationships to create revenue driving opportunities

Travel and Location

  • Approximately 25-50% travel, especially early on.

  • Preference for candidates near major hubs (for example Miami, New York, Los Angeles, Las Vegas), but open to other locations if you are excited to be on the road and can execute.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of closing experience in sales (SMB to mid-market), partnerships, or an early GTM role with clear ownership of revenue.

  • Comfortable in field sales environments: walking into businesses, earning trust fast, and hearing “no” a lot without losing your edge.

  • Charismatic, personable, and credible with tough, sharp customers who do not tolerate fluff.

  • Strong discovery and deal control: you can diagnose the real problem, keep urgency, and close.

  • High activity, high ownership, self-directed. You build the plan and run it.

  • Willing to work in a competitive environment where speed and execution matter.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into watch dealers, jewelers, luxury resale, collectibles, or other high-value, trust-based SMB verticals.

  • Familiarity with crypto and stablecoins, or strong curiosity and the ability to get fluent quickly.

  • Experience selling payments, fintech, FX, or treasury workflows.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Strategist, Agent Development (Dutch speaking)
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

  • Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

  • Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

  • Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

title: Content Reviewer - United States
description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
 
Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMastâ¢ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing networkâcombining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermasterâs SmartMastâ¢ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelorâs degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3â5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Technical Architect
description:
Role Description

As a Technical Architect at Dropbox, you will help enterprise customers translate business goals and complex technical requirements into practical solution architectures. You will work with customers and internal teams to design how Dropbox fits into their existing systems, validate critical assumptions, and guide implementation and adoption.

You will lead architecture discussions spanning workflows, integrations, identity and access, data movement, and operational readiness. You will explain design choices and tradeoffs, identify technical risks early, and produce clear guidance that implementation teams can act on. You will also turn lessons from customer engagements into reusable patterns and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with customer business and IT stakeholders to establish requirements, constraints, dependencies, and measurable success criteria.
  • Design and document solution architectures, including system boundaries, integration and data flows, identity and permission models, and operational requirements.
  • Evaluate design options and explain tradeoffs in reliability, security, performance, implementation effort, and ongoing cost.
  • Validate high-risk assumptions through focused prototypes, integration tests, or technical evaluations with explicit acceptance criteria.
  • Guide implementation and migration planning, defining sequencing, owners, testing, cutover, rollback, and handoff to delivery and support teams.
  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering to resolve technical blockers and connect architecture decisions to customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable reference architectures, implementation guidance, and enablement materials; mentor colleagues and communicate recurring product gaps.

Requirements

  • Customer-facing technical experience: At least 3 years in technical architecture, solutions architecture, implementation consulting, or a similar role, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and technical validation for enterprise SaaS customers.
  • AI experience: Experience using AI tools for technical analysis, solution design, or prototyping, including validating outputs, protecting customer data, and assessing limitations.
  • Integration expertise: Experience designing and troubleshooting API integrations, authentication, data flows, and failure handling.
  • Identity and access: Understanding of IAM and Zero Trust principles, including SSO, SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, conditional access, and how permissions and sharing affect data exposure.
  • Implementation and migration: Experience planning implementations or migrations and coordinating dependencies, technical risks, and handoffs across teams.
  • Technical communication: Ability to write clear technical documentation, lead workshops, and explain design decisions to technical and business audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Expertise in at least one of the following areas:

  • CASB/SSE/DLP platforms: Experience with enterprise security platforms such as Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Forcepoint, Broadcom/Symantec DLP, or similar technologies.

  • Identity and access management: Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, or Ping Identity, including managing identities, permissions, and groups and applying least-privilege access principles to SaaS applications.

  • Security ecosystems and integrations: Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, APIs, OAuth, event and audit logs, or security integrations, including an understanding of how SaaS and data security solutions fit into a customerâs broader security architecture.

  • Security and compliance frameworks: Experience applying frameworks or regulatory requirements such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS to address enterprise customer needs.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read thisÂ blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Design Working Student / Intern
description:
Join SE3 as Design Working Student / Intern

Design the visuals that show the world what we build, and learn the craft alongside our Creative Director.

About SE3

SE3 builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our creative team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As our Design Working Student or Intern, you'll be one of the first members of our new creative team. You'll work directly with our Creative Director and turn our brand into the visuals we need every week: LinkedIn posts, event and trade-show material, presentations and web graphics. What you design goes live quickly and is seen by customers, partners and future colleagues.

We're flexible on the format. As a working student, you'll work up to 20 hours a week during the semester and more during semester breaks; as an intern, you'll join us full-time. We'd like you to start in January 2027 and will plan around your exams. Much of our work is for defence, so expect drones, field tests and trade shows rather than consumer apps.

What You'll Work On

  • LinkedIn & Social: Design posts, carousels and short animations, working from the copy our content team writes.

  • Events & Trade Shows: Create roll-ups, flyers, booth graphics and other print material for the events we attend.

  • Presentations & Sales Material: Build slides, product sheets and one-pagers in our brand.

  • Web & Brand Assets: Prepare graphics for our website and keep our templates and brand assets up to date.

  • Faster Workflows: Help us produce more in less time with good templates and AI tools, without lowering the bar.

Your Profile

  • You're studying communication design, graphic design or a related subject, or you've just graduated. For the working-student option, you're enrolled at a university.

  • Your portfolio, from your studies or your own projects, shows real craft: typography, layout and an eye for detail.

  • You've done first work in web, print or motion, and you want to get better at all three.

  • You're confident in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud.

  • You work fast, take feedback well, show initiative and keep raising your own bar.

  • You communicate confidently in English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Design work for a startup, a student club or your own side project.

  • Motion design or video editing, for example in After Effects or Premiere Pro.

  • 3D, illustration or photography.

  • An interest in technology, drones or defence.

Perks & Benefits

  • Work That Goes Live: Your designs end up on LinkedIn, on our website and at trade shows

  • Mentorship: Work closely with our Creative Director and experienced engineers, and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (30 min): Let's get to know each other.

  2. Portfolio Review (60 min): Walk our Creative Director through your portfolio and work on a short design task together.

  3. Team Lunch: Meet the team on site and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides.

We value linguists who excel at software localization and brand storytelling, ensuring every string is clear, consistent, and culturally impactful.

  • Impactful Marketing Localization. Transform global campaigns and brand voices to hit home in the Somali-speaking market, maintaining the original creative spirit while maximizing local relevance.

  • Polished Product and E-commerce Copy. Localize product and UI listings applying regional naming logic and formatting standards.

  • Brand Integrity and Quality Assurance. Uphold elite quality benchmarks to provide engaging, audience-centric content aligned with brand identity.

  • Agile Team Collaboration. Coordinate with our production and quality leads to execute high-stakes projects on schedule and within client specifications.

  • Native-level proficiency in Somali.

  • A graduate qualification in translation, linguistics, or language studies, OR a graduate qualification in another field plus 2 years of full-time professional translation experience, OR 5 years of full-time professional translation experience.

  • The ability to follow terminology and reference materials precisely.

  • Proven professional experience in translation and localization within marketing, UI/software, or e-commerce content.

  • Experience with app or platform localization (mobile UI, social media, or web content) preferred.

title: Strategic Account Executive, UK & Ireland — Video Production, Media and Games
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

The role

Higgsfield is opening enterprise sales in Europe. You will own revenue from companies that make video in the UK and Ireland: film and TV producers, VFX and post-production studios, broadcasters, music and sports media, and game publishers.

This is a new-business role. You find the accounts, run the deals and close them yourself.

What you will do

  • Win new enterprise customers. Source, run and close multimillion deals with studios, broadcasters, production groups and game publishers.

  • Sell to four types of customer.

    • Film and TV: production companies and studio groups.

    • VFX, animation and post-production studios.

    • Broadcasters, streamers, music and sports media: in-house production and promo teams.

    • Games: publishers and studios that produce trailers and marketing video.

  • Run complex deals. Work with producers, heads of production, VFX supervisors, technology, procurement, legal and security teams on the customer side. Sales cycles run 6–12 months.

  • Turn pilots into annual contracts. Agree a paid pilot on a real project with clear success criteria and convert it into a yearly commitment.

  • Share customer feedback. Tell product and leadership what customers ask for, what blocks deals and what competitors offer.

Requirements

  • Enterprise AE experience. 4+ years as a B2B Enterprise Account Executive in a closing role, managing the full sales cycle. You have carried a multimillion annual new-business quota and met or exceeded it in most years.

  • Deals of $1M+ ARR. You have personally closed deals of $1M+ ARR in the last three years and can describe them in detail: who signed, how long the deal took, and what procurement and legal required.

  • Complex sales. Experience with 6–12 month sales cycles and several decision-makers, including C-level and VP-level buyers. You have negotiated enterprise contracts yourself and taken them through procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • Pipeline and forecasting. You build most of your pipeline through your own outbound, forecast accurately and keep the CRM up to date. Experience with MEDDPICC or a similar method.

  • Media and entertainment background. You have sold software, technology or content licensing to studios, broadcasters, post-production or game companies. You understand how a production is financed and made, from development and shooting to VFX, post-production and delivery, and who controls which budget.

  • London. Based in London, with the right to work in the UK and existing relationships with decision-makers at UK studios, broadcasters and production groups.

Skills

  • Outbound prospecting. You build your own pipeline and do not rely on inbound leads.

  • Stakeholder management. You manage several decision-makers in one deal at the same time.

  • Commercial skills. You can put together an offer with seats, usage commitments and a pilot, and explain the price to a CFO. You can turn project-based budgets into an annual contract.

  • Production knowledge. You understand production budgets and schedules, and where generative video fits: development, previsualisation, VFX, localisation and promo.

  • Rights and compliance. You can discuss IP, talent consent, union rules and data security with a customer's legal team.

  • Product knowledge. You run your own demos in Higgsfield and use AI tools in your daily work.

Nice to have

  • Experience selling generative AI, VFX or post-production software, or virtual production technology.

  • Experience selling to game publishers or mobile game studios.

  • A technical integration deal closed with a studio, such as an API or pipeline integration.

  • Experience as an early sales hire at a fast-growing company.

How we work

  • Six days a week. Our GTM team works six days a week, and the same applies in London.

  • Overlap with US hours. You will work with our US Enterprise team and company leadership, so part of your working day overlaps with US time zones.

  • Local hire. You are based in London and meet customers in person.

The deal

  • Competitive base salary in USD.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program.

  • Remote in Europe, with regular travel across the region and to Almaty.

  • Our GTM team works six days a week and overlaps with US hours. Expect the same pace wherever you are based.

  • Full-time position.

  • Opportunity to become the cornerstone of Higgsfield's European sales engine.

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are looking for a Physician Assistant (PA) Admissions Consultant! If you have experience serving on a PA program admissions committee and are passionate about mentorship, coaching, and helping students reach their full potential in the PA school admissions process, this could be the role for you. You’ll work closely with prospective PA students to track their progress, strengthen their applications, and guide them through every step of the PA school admissions journey, including CASPA applications. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

  • Work with prospective PA program candidates, helping them identify opportunities to enhance their profiles and draft compelling application materials
  • Manage relationships with applicants and families while providing strategic and tactical guidance on school selection, personal statements, resumes, recommendations, interviews, and the overall PA program application process
  • Identify optimal PA programs for individual students; provide detailed feedback and guidance on their research into specific programs, ensuring alignment with the student’s background, goals, and specialty interests
  • Support students with project planning, helping them create and adhere to effective timelines through Excel-based trackers or other tools
  • Stay up-to-date on the PA school application process, including CASPA (Centralized Application Service for Physician Assistants) requirements, GRE preparation, clinical hour expectations, and program-specific criteria, to advise prospective and existing clients on appropriate program selection and application strategies

Qualifications

  • Graduated from a top U.S. Physician Assistant program
  • Admissions Committee Experience: Previous experience serving on a PA program admissions committee or selection board, offering valuable insights into the admissions process
  • Experience in PA program admissions counseling, coaching, or related fields
  • A passion for mentoring and guiding students
  • Strong planning and organizational skills to assist students in managing complex application timelines
  • Exceptional English reading, writing, and editing skills to support students in crafting impactful application materials

  • Expertise in project management to help students stay on track during the rigorous application process
  • Experience in education, coaching, tutoring, or admission consulting

title: Localization Production Coordinator
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com

Job Overview

Want to help bring a world-class digital product to audiences around the globe? As a Production Coordinator on our client’s Localization team, you’ll support the localization of product features, marketing campaigns, editorial content, and web experiences across multiple markets. You’ll work alongside Senior Coordinators and Project Managers to deliver high-quality work on time, while building your expertise in localization operations and cross-functional collaboration.

This role is built to grow. The localization function is shifting toward AI-first workflows, and over the next 12 months you’ll move from supported operational work toward independently running AI-assisted localization workflows. You’ll run traditional processes while building the skills to be the human judgment layer for AI output, and you’ll take on greater cross-functional ownership along the way. We’re hiring for today’s work and for where this role is heading.

Main Responsibilities

  • Facilitate the end-to-end localization workflow for product features, marketing campaigns, editorial, and web content, with guidance from Senior Coordinators or Project Managers
  • Work with designers, product owners, engineers, marketers, and internal reviewers to gather localization requirements and track open action items
  • Collaborate with external vendors on query management, file handoffs, and delivery timelines
  • Monitor project status and flag risks or blockers to stakeholders early

title: QA Analyst-Ambulatory Ops
description:
Job Title

QA Analyst-Ambulatory Operations

About the Department

Join the Customer Service department at Henry Ford Health, a leader in healthcare delivery. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional support to our members and ensuring the highest standards of quality and professionalism. We work closely with various support departments to maintain seamless operations and uphold the Henry Ford Health commitment to excellence in patient care and service.

Role Overview

As a QA Analyst-Ambulatory Operations, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and improving the quality of customer service within our call center. You will monitor staff performance, conduct audits, and provide feedback to ensure member inquiries are handled professionally and efficiently. Your work will directly contribute to enhancing the overall customer experience and supporting the operational goals of Henry Ford Health.

Why Henry Ford Health

At Henry Ford Health, we are relentless advocates for exceptional care for our patients, communities, and each other. We come to do meaningful work and grow our careers, and we stay for the connection, support, and shared pride in making the impossible, possible.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and assess processes and workflows to ensure staff maintain quality and production measures.
  • Conduct random audits and quality checks to evaluate the handling of member inquiries.
  • Compile monitored data and participate in coaching, training, and development of department agents.
  • Facilitate calibration sessions and training for new hires and current staff on audit processes and quality expectations.
  • Provide ongoing reporting and feedback to management regarding staff performance.
  • Implement efforts to maintain or increase the quality of work performed within Customer Service.

What You Will Need

Required Qualifications

  • Experience providing coaching, feedback, and facilitating training.
  • Experience implementing process change, data analysis, and trend reporting.
  • Excellent documentation, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Self-directed and self-motivated with strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Epic systems.
  • Associate degree in Business Administration or related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Two (2) years of experience in call center customer service.
  • One (1) year of experience conducting quality/performance/evaluation audits.
  • Strong understanding of the Henry Ford Health healthcare delivery system.

What We Offer

At Henry Ford Health, we offer opportunities for career growth, collaboration with dedicated professionals, and the chance to contribute to mission-driven work. You'll engage in continuous learning and development, working alongside a supportive team committed to making a difference in healthcare.

Join Our Team

Ready to make an impact? Apply now to join our team at Henry Ford Health and help us deliver exceptional care and service.

Henry Ford Health partners with millions of people on their health journey, across Michigan and around the world. We offer a full continuum of services from primary and preventative care to complex and specialty care, health insurance, a full suite of home health offerings, virtual care, pharmacy, eye care and other health care retail. With former Ascension southeast Michigan and Flint region locations now part of our team, Henry Ford's care is available in 13 hospitals and hundreds of ambulatory care locations. Based in Detroit, Henry Ford is one of the nation's most respected academic medical centers and is leading the Future of Health: Detroit, a $3 billion investment anchored by a reimagined Henry Ford academic healthcare campus.
